title: graph-server: GraphNode/GraphEdge create ignores #creation-id refs
description: draft-atwood-jmap-graph-00 L277 (jmap-chat-spec 6c38e2f): 'Like any id-typed property, `graphId` may reference a Graph created earlier in the same request by its creation id (RFC8620 Section 5.3).' crate-jmap-graph-server/src/node.rs create_graph_id reads graphId literally and never consults HandlerContext created_ids or same-call creates, so '#g' fails with invalidProperties graphId. Pre-existing (before JMAP-k9va the literal '#g' failed the rights lookup with the same error); found during the JMAP-k9va review fix. Audit fromId/toId and sibling servers (vtc callId, chat replyTo/memberIds) for the same gap.
close_reason: Batch 21: already fixed at HEAD (j31d by ff168a9d; 1mr0 by da5b3e45/otw0)
